description:
2.5mm or 4.4mm balanced upgrade cable for 99 Classics and 99 Neo. Will also work with any 3.5mm TS connection headphone.

1.3m (4.2 ft) OFC Silver Plated

2.5mm or 4.4mm TRRS balanced connection

2 x 3.5mm TS connection

Soft transparent TPU coating
name: Meze Audio 99 Series 2.5mm or 4.4mm Replacement Cable
